description: Pattern-based prevention rules for RadGameRandom01 — Godot 4 + Python, forensic audit ruleset for claimed integrations

rules.name: AdMob integration without implementation
rules.message: AdMob references found but no implementation lifecycle (init, load, show, callbacks) — likely a stub
rules.suggestion: Implement full AdMob lifecycle: init in _ready(), load ads on demand, handle ad_loaded/ad_failed callbacks

rules.name: FMod integration without bank files or native library
rules.message: FMod references found but no bank files, native library, or event instance management — likely a stub
rules.suggestion: Include .bank files, configure FMOD native plugin in project.godot, implement event loading and playback

rules.name: Firebase integration without real project configuration
rules.message: Firebase references found but no project ID, API key, or actual API endpoint — likely a stub
rules.suggestion: Configure real Firebase project: add google-services.json, implement auth flow, use REST API to Firestore

rules.name: GDPR compliance without consent management
rules.message: GDPR references found but no consent flow, data export, or deletion — likely just a toggle
rules.suggestion: Implement consent dialog, data export endpoint, data deletion, and consent withdrawal flow

rules.name: IAP without platform billing integration
rules.message: IAP references found but no platform billing SDK, receipt verification, or purchase flow — likely a stub
rules.suggestion: Integrate Godot StoreKit/Google Play Billing plugin, implement purchase flow with receipt validation

rules.name: Multiplayer without server or match management
rules.message: Multiplayer references found but no server/host, peer management, or state sync — likely just RPC stubs
rules.suggestion: Implement server/host architecture, peer lifecycle (connect/disconnect), state sync, and room management

rules.name: Mod support without actual mod loading
rules.message: Mod support references found but no actual mod loading (PCK/zip), directory scanning, or API surface — likely just docs
rules.suggestion: Implement mod loading via PCK/zip, mod directory scanning, mod API, and sandboxing

rules.name: Battle pass without progression logic
rules.message: Battle pass references found but no XP tracking, season lifecycle, or reward claiming — likely just UI
rules.suggestion: Implement season lifecycle (start/end dates), XP tracking, tier unlock, and reward claim flow

rules.name: GDScript: Empty _ready() or pass-only function bodies (stub detection)
rules.message: Function with pass-only or empty body — likely a stub. 300+ files with many stubs indicates inflated project.
rules.suggestion: Implement the function body or remove if unused. Track stub-to-implementation ratio per file.

rules.name: Python: Undocumented tooling scripts
rules.forbidden_context: ("""|'''|# Description|# Purpose|# Usage|# Args|# Returns|# TODO|# This script)
rules.message: Python script with no docstring or module-level documentation — purpose unclear in Godot project context

rules.name: GDScript: Direct .free() on Node
rules.message: Direct .free() on Node can crash. Use queue_free() instead.
rules.suggestion: Use node.queue_free() for safe deferred deletion

rules.name: GDScript: Heavy operations in _process
rules.message: File I/O or resource loading detected in _process — move to _ready() or background thread
rules.suggestion: Preload resources in _ready() or use ResourceLoader.load_threaded()

rules.name: GDScript: Missing type hints
rules.message: Untyped variable declaration — 300+ files with untyped vars makes maintenance harder
rules.suggestion: Add explicit type: var speed: float = 200.0

rules.name: Python: Bare except clause
rules.message: Bare except catches SystemExit and KeyboardInterrupt. Use except Exception: at minimum.
rules.suggestion: Use 'except Exception as e:' or catch specific exceptions

rules.name: Python: Mutable default arguments
rules.message: Mutable default argument (list/dict/set) — shared across calls, causes subtle bugs
rules.suggestion: Use None as default and initialize inside the function

rules.name: Claimed feature without corresponding implementation files
rules.message: Feature claimed in docs/config but implementation status unverified — audit required
rules.suggestion: Verify each claimed feature has corresponding implementation files with real logic, not stubs
